title: Is Cam Ward already the 2nd-best quarterback in the AFC South?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Is Cam Ward already the 2nd-best quarterback in the AFC South?
sources.description: The Tennessee Titans finished last place in the AFC South last season for the second consecutive campaign. It wasn’t particularly close. The 3-14 Titans trailed the third-place Indianapolis Colts (8-9) by five victories. One thing that could change the Titans’ fortunes in the AFC South is the ascension of quarterback Cam Ward.
